text:
maya: Heads-up — customer legal team asked for a way to place temporary legal holds on audit logs (preserve events beyond retention). Asking how this maps to our retention primitives and BYOK requirements.
sam: Key concerns: chain-of-custody, immutable retention flag, and KMS access patterns for BYOK customers. Also we need an audit trail showing who set the hold and when.
lina: +1. From product POV we should avoid creating new storage tiers. Prefer a flag on existing log objects that prevents deletion until explicitly released.
ben: Tech constraints: our current retention is time-based TTL per-tenant stored in metadata. We can add `legal_hold:true` that disables TTL deletion. But for BYOK, key rotation/escrow could make old logs unreadable unless we manage key retention.
jordan: For SOC2 evidence we need to show proof of retention change and approval path. So UI + API + an event in the audit log that records the hold request and release, with approver id.
maya: Proposed MVP scope:
- API to create/release legal hold (tenant-scoped)
- UI flow in Console (admin-only) with explicit confirmation and reason field
- Audit events for hold/release
- No auto-scan for PII; customers are responsible to request holds
Is that reasonable to ship quickly?
sam: Sounds good. Need to add: for BYOK customers, holds must also pin the key in KMS for the duration of the hold, or we must surface a warning that if customer rotates/escrows keys we may not be able to decrypt older logs.
lina: UX detail: show active holds on tenant page with expiration (optional) and link to audit record. Also a lightweight legal-hold export (CSV) for legal teams.
ben: Implementation note: locking TTL by flag is cheap. Key pinning is trickier. Options:
1) Ask customer to add a key retention policy on their KMS (recommended)
2) Offer an opt-in key-escrow with strict access controls (legal/ops approval)
3) If neither, we can store logs encrypted with a platform key when a hold is placed (needs compliance signoff)
We should scope 1 for MVP and document tradeoffs.
maya: Prioritization ask from sales: a Fortune 100 trial is blocked pending this feature. They want 30-day holds and a signed attestation. Do we treat this as P0 for Dedicated/Private customers?
sam: I think P0 for Dedicated + Private, P1 for Hosted. For hosted, we can offer a manual support-managed workflow while we build the self-serve flow.
jordan: Launch criteria checklist (draft):
- API endpoints: POST /v1/legal-hold, DELETE /v1/legal-hold
- Console: create/release flows + list
- Audit trail visible and exportable
- BYOK guidance published + recommended KMS config
- Security review completed
- E2E test for TTL suppression
If all done, we can ship to Dedicated and Private customers.
maya: Example API snippet for discussion:
```
POST /v1/legal-hold
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-corp",
  "reason": "litigation - case 1234",
  "requested_by": "legal@acme.com",
  "expires_at": null  // or ISO timestamp
}
```
Response should include hold_id, created_by, created_at.
lina: Also include optional `release_policy` (manual | auto) and `escalation_contact` for legal.
ben: Security: ensure only users with `admin:holds` permission can call the API. Record IP and auth method in the audit entry.
sam: KMS alignment: add a note in developer docs: for BYOK, customer must set kms:DisableKeyDeletion and set key policy to allow Redwood to GetDecrypt for logs while hold is active. Or choose escrow.
maya: Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: customer rotates/deletes key -> logs unrecoverable. Mitigate: clear guidance and button in Console to request escrow before placing hold.
- Risk: abused holds -> inflate storage costs. Mitigate: rate-limit holds per tenant and require reason + TTL where possible.
jordan: Compliance asks: legal wants signed attestation that we will not delete held logs. For Hosted we can provide attestations only for specific contracts. For Dedicated/Private, easier to provide contract language.
alex-legal-bot: Automated reminder: please attach a sample attestation template to this thread when ready. Use internal doc ID: LEG-RET-2026-01.
maya: Action items:
- ben: prototype API + TTL-disabled flag (due in 5d)
- lina: Console mockups + CSV export UX (due in 7d)
- sam: KMS/BYOK guidance draft + security checklist (due in 4d)
- jordan: Draft launch criteria doc and attestation template (due in 6d)
- maya: coordinate with sales on interim support workflow (today)

ben: I’ll spike and post notes. Quick Q: do we want a soft-UI confirmation modal explaining BYOK caveat? UX suggested.
lina: Yes — modal with two checkboxes: "I confirm key retention/escrow is configured" and "I understand Redwood may not decrypt logs if keys are rotated" ✅
maya: Thanks everyone. If we hit blockers I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
sam: tagging @security-ops for visibility. We'll review the key escrow option.
ben: posting prototype link in a follow-up thread.
maya: closing here — will convert action items into GH tasks after prototypes are up.
